rec.name: Testimonial Videos Slider
rec.status: Built — installed in the Sectionfy theme (HK PÄDS); ticket awaiting client feedback

what.text: A horizontally swipeable row of vertical customer testimonial videos. On desktop, a text column sits to the left with a heading, subheading and underlined arrow CTA link. A round dark badge overlaps the top-left corner of the video row (e.g. '300,000+ customers love …'). Each video shows a thumbnail with a large semi-transparent play icon. Clicking plays or pauses the video, and native controls appear only while it is playing. The ticket is a bundle order of about 12 sections (Logo Slider, Countdown, Benefits, Testimonials, Review Spotlight, Cart Shipping Bar and others). Only this section has code and a screenshot, so only it is documented here.

why.text: Real people speaking about the product is stronger social proof than written reviews. It is harder to fake, so it builds trust and lowers purchase anxiety. The badge adds a large-number bandwagon cue ('300,000+ customers'). Short vertical clips follow familiar TikTok/Reels habits, so they invite casual browsing. Because the videos sit in a swipe row, shoppers can sample several voices without leaving the page.

how.text: Build a custom Liquid section with a schema. The header (heading, subheading, optional CTA link) comes from text settings. A 'video' block holds an MP4 URL and a thumbnail image picker, and the merchant adds one block per testimonial. Videos render inside a Slick carousel with variableWidth, no arrows or dots and infinite off, so they swipe horizontally. Desktop cards are 284×367px and mobile cards are 224×360px. Desktop uses a flex layout with a fixed 295px header column. JS hides the play icon and enables native controls while a video plays, restores them on pause, and toggles play/pause on click. Slick is re-initialised on the 'shopify:section:load' event so the theme editor works. The badge is absolutely positioned: top-right above the row on mobile, overlapping the top-left on desktop.

items: Button text and button link (CTA under the header)
Badge text color and badge background color
Video blocks: video URL (MP4) and video thumbnail (image picker)

dependencies.text: The theme must load jQuery and the Slick carousel library, because the section calls $.slick. It also assumes a '.container' class. Videos must be hosted as direct MP4 URLs (e.g. Shopify Files or a CDN) and are not uploaded through a native video picker. Thumbnails are uploaded as images. No metafields or apps are required. Possible code issues: the schema has a trailing comma after the last setting, which Shopify may reject, and the slider initialisation JS runs inline, possibly before jQuery or Slick are ready (inferred).

items: Video play rate (plays per section view)
Average watch time and completion rate
PDP add-to-cart rate and conversion rate (test vs. control)
Bounce rate on pages with the section

images.caption: Desktop layout: left text column (heading, subheading, underlined arrow CTA), dark round badge overlapping the top-left of the video row, and four vertical video cards. The cards show placeholder product thumbnails.
